build_example_plot: build a plot showing image, reconstruction, mask, and components from IODINE run info
build_iterations_plot: build a multi-iteration plot showing reconstruction and mask evolution across IODINE timesteps
build_inputs_plot: build a plot visualizing all spatial inputs like masks, posteriors, and coordinates for IODINE
create_show_img: create an image display with optional masking and normalization on a matplotlib axis
create_show_mask: create a colored mask visualization from a one-hot encoded mask tensor
